create_BaseKeyPointAnnotator: create an abstract base class for keypoint annotators with an annotate method
build_VertexAnnotator: build a vertex annotator to draw circles at keypoint locations on an image
build_EdgeAnnotator: build an edge annotator to draw lines connecting keypoints into skeleton structures
build_VertexLabelAnnotator: build a vertex label annotator to draw labeled boxes at each keypoint position
run_annotate_method: run the annotate method on any annotator to draw keypoints edges or labels on an image
